{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Republican party wants to expand opportunity instead of government.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Governor Bush calls expanding opportunity \"the Duty of Hope.\"",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican party sees expanding opportunity as its duty to act.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The old left-liberal order of social policy has collapsed in failure.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The failure of the old left-liberal order of social policy was most egregious among the poor and those on the margins of society.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The time is here to act, to bring hope, and to expand opportunity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republican governors sparked a revolution that brought about the greatest social policy change in nearly 60 years — welfare reform.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Congressional Republicans passed landmark welfare reform legislation in 1996.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Welfare reform legislation has helped millions of Americans break the cycle of welfare and gain independence for their families.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"About six million Americans are now gainfully employed because of welfare reform legislation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Welfare reform legislation turned welfare resources and decision-making back to the states.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Welfare reform legislation requires recipients to meet a work requirement.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Assistance provided through welfare reform legislation is only temporary.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
